Kwa hesabu sahihi: TZS 700,000 × 20% = TZS 140,000; TZS 550,000 × 20% = TZS 110,000; TZS 300,000 × 20% = TZS 60,000. Jumla ya michango ya mwajiri: TZS 210,000 + TZS 160,000 + TZS 60,000 = TZS 430,000. Michango ya wafanyakazi: TZS 140,000 + TZS 110,000 + TZS 60,000 = TZS 310,000. TZS 900,000 × 20% = TZS 180,000

Kwa hesabu sahihi: TZS 450,000 × 15% + TZS 1,000,000 × 20% = TZS 67,500 + TZS 200,000 = TZS 267,500. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

Kwa wafanyakazi 14, mgawanyo unaotakiwa ni sawa — 7 wanaopata TZS 620,000 na 7 wanaopata TZS 380,000. Sehemu ya mwajiri kwa kila mmoja: TZS 620,000 → TZS 52,000; TZS 380,000 → TZS 38,000. Jumla ya sehemu ya mwajiri: TZS 520,000 × 7 = TZS 3,640,000. Thibitisha hesabu hii na NSSF (nssf.or.tz).
